title: claims reply
description: What the claims model returns for one section of a source (corpuslm.claims): the claims it makes, each tied to the section's lines by index.

claims.description: The claims the section makes, in the order they are made.

statement.description: One plain sentence of at most 25 words, a restatement in the model's words.

speaker.description: The speaker label as shown on the cited lines, or empty.

segments.description: Indexes of the lines the claim comes from, clearest first; the pass keeps the first six.

items.description: A line index from the section.

kind.description: One of assertion, definition, example, story, question, prediction, disagreement.
